# `vox-skills`

**Crate:** `vox-skills` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Skill marketplace and plugin architecture for the Vox agent system

## Crate Overview

# vox-skills — Skill Marketplace and Plugin Architecture

Provides a typed skill registry, skill bundle format parsing,
plugin lifecycle management, and an optional Vox Skills HTTP bridge.

Submodules carry detailed docs; the crate root re-exports stable types for embedders.

## Public API Surface

### Modules

| Module | Description |
|---|---|
| `builtins` | — |
| `bundle` | In-memory skill bundle (`VoxSkillBundle`) and JSON (de)serialization. |
| `hooks` | Lifecycle hook registry and event types. |
| `manifest` | Skill manifest schema (`SkillManifest`, categories, permissions). |
| `parser` | Parse `SKILL.md` (YAML/TOML front matter + body) into a bundle. |
| `plugin` | Plugin trait, skill-backed plugins, and `PluginManager`. |
| `provider` | Shared `Arc<SkillRegistry>` factory for MCP and CLI surfaces. |
| `registry` | Install, uninstall, search, and list skills (`SkillRegistry`). |
| `registry_api` | HTTP client for the remote skills marketplace (`skills-registry` feature). |
| `sandbox` | Unified container sandbox for community skill execution.  Uses `vox-container`'s Docker/Podman backend — the same infrastructure used for `.vox` application deployment — to sandbox untrusted skills. |
